An Italian Herbal, classified by Baumann as one of the 'North Italian group' and as a copy of Paris, Bibliothèque de l'Ecole des Beaux-Arts, MS Masson 116 (see Baumann, Das Erbario Carrarese, 1974).

Decoration:

Full-page miniatures on each folio of plants in colours, mostly in greens and browns, with captions, and often accompanied by animals or people.

Materials: Parchment codex.

Dimensions: 360 x 255 mm.

Foliation: ff. 108 + vi (+ 1 unfoliated leaf after f. 10, and 6 unfoliated paper leaves; 3 at the beginning and 3 at the end).

Script: Gothic.

Binding: Post-1600. Green leather with blind tooling in form of flowers and fleurs-de-lys.
attributes.label: Physical Characteristics

attributes.value:
Origin: Lombardy, Italy.

Nicholas Joseph Foucault (b. 1643, d. 1721), marquis de Magny, statesman and archaeologist: his book-plate with the legend 'EX BIBLIOTHECA | NICOLAI JOSEPH FOUCAULT | COMITIS CONSISTORIANI' with his arms sable a lion rampant, dexter, crowned argent, as supporters two lions argent; a couronne de marquis surmounting the shield (f. 1r).

Sir Hans Sloane (b. 1660, d. 1753), baronet, physician and collector: inscription 'Bibliotheca Sloaniana' (f. 1r).

Former shelfmark (?) '5Vh' , and crossed out (ff. 1r, 1v).

Purchased as part of the Sloane collection from Sloane's executors and incorporated into the newly founded British Museum in 1753.
